theme: Reading the backend docs: resources, REST APIs and idempotent requests

terms.definition: A thing a server manages, such as a user or an order, that has its own address.
terms.example: Each user is a resource with its own address.
terms.code:
import Foundation
let base = "https://x.com"
let users = URL(string: base + "/users")!
let one = users.appendingPathComponent("42")
print(one.path)

terms.definition: A web service where each resource has its own URL and the HTTP method says what to do.
terms.example: Our backend is a REST API with JSON replies.
terms.code:
import Foundation
let u = URL(string: "https://x.com/users/42")!
var r = URLRequest(url: u)
r.httpMethod = "DELETE"
print(r.httpMethod!, r.url!.path)

terms.definition: A property of a request that has the same effect whether you send it once or many times.
terms.example: A PUT request is idempotent, so a retry is safe.
terms.code:
var a = 0, b = 0
func put() { a = 10 }    // idempotent
func post() { b += 10 }  // not idempotent
put(); put(); post(); post()
print(a, b)

video.description:
Learn to explain the words in backend API docs: Resource, REST API & Idempotent, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Resource - A thing a server manages, such as a user or an order, that has its own address.
REST API - A web service where each resource has its own URL and the HTTP method says what to do.
Idempotent - A property of a request that has the same effect whether you send it once or many times.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Explain Resource, REST API & Idempotent in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
Resource, REST API, Idempotent 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Resource - A thing a server manages, such as a user or an order, that has its own address.
한국어: Resource: 사용자나 주문처럼 서버가 관리하며 자기만의 주소를 가진 대상

REST API - A web service where each resource has its own URL and the HTTP method says what to do.
한국어: REST API: 각 리소스가 자기 URL을 갖고 HTTP 메서드가 할 일을 알려 주는 웹 서비스

Idempotent - A property of a request that has the same effect whether you send it once or many times.
한국어: Idempotent: 한 번 보내든 여러 번 보내든 효과가 같은 요청의 성질

landscape.hook: Can you explain Resource, REST API and Idempotent in English?

dialogue.title: Words in the docs

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, what does the word resource mean in the backend docs?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A resource is a thing the server manages, like a user or an order. It has its own address.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And the docs say REST API everywhere.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A REST API gives each resource its own URL, and the HTTP method says what to do.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So GET reads a resource and `PUT` updates it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. That is the idea of a REST API.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Why do the docs say `PUT` is idempotent?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Idempotent means the same effect if you send it once or ten times.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So a retry after a timeout is safe for an idempotent request?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Be careful with POST, because it is not idempotent.
Each user is a resource with its own address.
